edgeTimestampProperty.description: The name of the property on the edges that contains the timestamp data for that edge.

edgeTimestampsProperty.description: The name of the property on the edges that contains the timestamps data for that edge.

edgeTimeIntervalProperty.description: The name of the property on the edges that contains the time interval data for that edge.

edgeTimeIntervalsProperty.description: The name of the property on the edges that contains the time intervals data for that edge.

nodeTimestampProperty.description: The name of the property on the nodes that contains the timestamp data for that node.

nodeTimestampsProperty.description: The name of the property on the nodes that contains the timestamps data for that node.

nodeTimeIntervalProperty.description: The name of the property on the nodes that contains the time interval data for that node.

nodeTimeIntervalsProperty.description: The name of the property on the nodes that contains the time intervals data for that node.

showTimeBarControls.description: When set to false, the controls for the time bar will not be visible

showDisconnectedNodes.description:
When set to false, nodes without links are filtered out of the canvas; otherwise, disconnected nodes are still
displayed.

showNonTemporalData.description:
When set to false, edges that do not have a timestamp are filtered out of the canvas; otherwise, non-temporal edges
are still displayed.

backgroundColor.description: The background color for the time bar.

color.description: The color used for the bars of the time bar.

hoverColor.description: The color when a bar is hovered on by the user.

isHistogram.description: When set to true, time bar data is displayed as histogram; otherwise, displayed as smooth.

animation.description: Controls animations on the graph's time bar.

mode.description:
When set to 'filter', nodes and edges are removed from the canvas when filtered by the time bar.
When set to 'dim', nodes and edges are dimmed when filtered by the time bar.

controlsConfig.description: The configuration for the controls of the time bar.
